# SavrenAI Python standard (pointer)

The single source of truth is `.opencode/skill/python-standard/SKILL.md`,
which owns the rules and the bundled `audit_python_standard.py`. This file
is only a pointer so that tooling scanning `.github/skills/` and tooling
scanning `.opencode/skill/` cannot drift. Read the canonical file, follow
it, and run its audit before every commit.
